_comment: Waivers for check-procursus-shadow.py. Format: {package: {rule: reason}}. Every entry is an ACCEPTED divergence from the Procursus package of the same name — new divergence must earn its own entry with a reason. Seeded 2026-07-08 after the sqlite/openssl/harfbuzz device brick.

fontconfig.version: 2.17.1 bump predates the gate; soname kept; device-validated weeks on-device

libfontconfig1.version: 2.17.1 bump predates the gate; soname libfontconfig.1 kept; device-validated
libfontconfig1.symbols: 4 entry points Procursus's 2.14.0 exports and 2.17.1 cannot: checked against the 2.17.1 source 2026-07-29, _FcDefaultFini / _FcFreeTypeIsExclusiveLang / _FcFreeTypeLangSet are gone from the tree entirely and _FcConfigPathFini survives only in the internal src/fcint.h. Upstream removals, not build flags. Full-repo + Procursus-consumer import scan: zero importers

libfreetype6.version: 2.13.3 bump predates the gate; soname libfreetype.6 kept; device-validated

_comment_fribidi: libfribidi0/libfribidi-dev waivers REMOVED 2026-07-29: we stopped shipping fribidi entirely rather than waive it. Our 1.0.13 exported 36 symbols against Procursus 1.0.10's 49 -- a strict SUBSET, shadowing a superset. No package in the repo imported a single symbol only 1.0.13 had, and on device the same bidi text rendered pixel-identically (md5 f19b96216146) under both. A shadow that adds nothing and removes 13 symbols is not something to waive; it is something to delete. If fribidi is ever rebuilt, note that lib/meson.build sets gnu_symbol_visibility: 'hidden' and the char-set helpers carry no FRIBIDI_ENTRY, so a meson build can never match Procursus's autotools build that leaked them.

libxml2.version: 2.13.8 bump (ladybird needs modern libxml2); soname libxml2.2 kept; device-validated
libxml2.symbols: 2.13.8+ios2 rebuilds with every optional module on (--with-legacy/http/ftp/lzma/sax1/output, all default-OFF in 2.13), taking the gap from 194 symbols to 72 and restoring _xmlNanoHTTP* — which fixed our libgsf-1-114, and with it gnumeric/libgoffice. The 72 left are upstream-hidden internals (_xmlBuf*, _xmlCharEnc*, ___xmlRaiseError) and the DocBook SAX API deleted at 2.12; no flag brings those back. Import scan 2026-07-29 finds exactly one importer left: Procursus python3-libxml2 needs _docbDefaultSAXHandlerInit + _xmlXPtrEvalRangePredicate. It is not in any xios-* flavor closure, its only reverse-dep is the build-time tool itstool, and it is not installed on the reference device. Closing it properly means shipping our own python3-libxml2 built from 2.13.8's bindings (needs a staged target python3)

libsqlite3-1.symbols: FIXED in 3.52.0+ios3 by adding SQLITE_ENABLE_PREUPDATE_HOOK + SQLITE_ENABLE_SESSION: 52 missing -> 3, and we now export 343 symbols against Procursus's 317. The 3 left (_sqlite3_fts3_may_be_corrupt, _sqlite3_fts5_may_be_corrupt, _sqlite3_unsupported_selecttrace) only exist under SQLITE_DEBUG/SQLITE_TEST, which bring assert() and query tracing that no shipping build should carry. Zero importers

_comment_libsdl2: libsdl2-2.0-0 waiver ADDED AND WITHDRAWN 2026-08-02. The first version argued ABI parity from the install name and symlink chain alone -- that is not a symbol check, and the gate was right to keep failing. Our 2.32.10+ios2 is built SDL_XIOS_WAYLAND=ON / SDL_X11=OFF and exports 836 symbols but ZERO of _SDL_UIKitRunApp and _SDL_OnApplicationDidChangeStatusBarOrientation, both of which Procursus's 2.0.14 exports (verified on device 2026-08-02). libsdl2-2.0-0 has Procursus reverse-dependencies -- ffmpeg, libavdevice59 and powder, the last a UIKit SDL app -- so publishing a Wayland-only build under that name replaces theirs repo-wide, which is the openssl shape. Follow the ladybird-tls precedent instead: vendor under a private name with a private library path, and have the games depend on that. Do not re-add this waiver.
